scene: Babel BB-8 after battle — partial first draft

source.version_difference: CN and EN align at all 241 text-bearing source positions by physical line and type. EN has one additional terminal newline. The 549 non-text control commands match exactly. Speaker labels and text payloads are localized: 55 Sticker, 12 Subtitle, five Decision, and two multiline payloads differ by language. No source command-parameter differences were found. The translated first segment contains 40 positions (29 named, 11 narration); its command lines and markup align exactly.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: Scareye insists that Ascalon did not kill him.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN recasts the opening as a rhetorical dismissal of the prophecy.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Аскалон меня не убила! Не убила!
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the repeated CN assertion.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the Cyclops Court a huge joke.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Королевский двор циклопов — одна большая шутка!
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and omits the added adjective.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN repeats that Scareye did not die at Ascalon's hands, then refers to his own prophecy.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Я не погиб от руки Аскалон. Не погиб так, как сам себе предсказывал…
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian keeps the repeated denial in a concise Russian form.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the mercenaries can return to the Scar Market and secure their position if Babel loses.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN reduces the consequence to 'nothing to lose'.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN reference to their position.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly identifies the men as ambushers Scareye himself placed there.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN calls them soldiers he set up for an ambush.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …наёмников, которых сам же расставил здесь в засаде.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the ambush and Scareye's responsibility.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says Theresis respects compatriots who come before him one after another at the cost of their lives.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds an explanation about fighting their way out.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …сородичей, которые один за другим пробивались к нему, ставя на кон собственную жизнь.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN image without adding the EN explanation.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the traitors lying in ambush around them have probably prepared for a long time.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds the metaphor of sharpening their blades.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and does not add the sharpening metaphor.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN identifies Manfred as a guard officer attached to the General; it does not specify the rank 'captain'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Но я — офицер охраны генерала, ассасин.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the less specific CN wording and does not add a rank.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says she faces countless threats while in Kazdel.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds 'just as we are here'.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Вы участвуете в гонке, а она в Казделе сталкивается с бесчисленными угрозами —
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and omits the added EN comparison.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the targets 刽子手, literally executioners.
CN explicitly orders all inside agents/infiltrators to act and disarm patrol troops.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN generalizes this to all operations within the city.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Передайте всем нашим агентам внутри города приказ действовать: разоружить патрульные отряды.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN reference to inside agents.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly says to defeat the forces one by one before they regroup.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN says to strike before they can regroup but omits the one-by-one detail.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Разбейте их поодиночке, пока они не успели объединиться. Быстро.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the CN instruction to defeat them individually.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the Sarkaz look toward the ruins 不约而同, acting in unison / as if by agreement.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN only says they gaze at the same ruins.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …словно сговорившись, устремляли взгляды к руинам в центре города.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN detail of acting in unison.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN specifies damage to Kazdel's main urban districts (主城区).
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the CN specification of the main urban area.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses 凄苦 as a compact expression of sorrow and suffering.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian keeps one compact emotional term rather than duplicating the idea.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says there is no longer room for strategic gambits and calculations (博弈和算计); the assassins must be defeated directly.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN renders this as no wagering or planning our way out.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: никакие расчёты и уловки не помогут — остаётся лишь в открытом бою разгромить этих ассасинов
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN emphasis on abandoning calculations and confronting the assassins directly.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN uses 心神 for the minds/consciousness linked by the elegy.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the mental/spiritual link rather than making it a physical connection.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the Sarkaz a 弱势群体, a disadvantaged or vulnerable group.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN sense of social vulnerability rather than implying inherent weakness.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the Sarkaz will corrupt the land with Originium (源石腐化大地).
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN uses the same broad image.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian expresses the land contamination in the established Originium terminology.

notes: The original CN and EN game scripts were read from the attributed Kengxxiao mirrors; no complete source scripts are copied into this repository.
The full source contains 241 text-bearing positions: 141 named, 26 narration, 55 Sticker, two multiline, 12 Subtitle and five Decision positions.
CN has 790 physical lines; EN has 791 because of one extra terminal newline. All 241 text-bearing positions align by physical source line and type.
The 549 non-text control commands match exactly. Localized Sticker, Subtitle, Decision and multiline payloads are content, not command-structure differences.
This update translates ordinals 41–80, source lines 158–328: 27 named dialogue lines, seven narration lines and six Sticker text payloads.
The cumulative partial draft contains 80/241 positions. The next text position is ordinal 81 at CN source line 329.

Documented CN/EN meaning differences include Manfred's guard rank, the omitted EN comparison in Theresis's race metaphor, the term for executioners, the identity of inside agents, the one-by-one instruction, and the Sarkaz acting in unison.
The translated segment preserves all source command parameters and text-bearing command structure. No full CN/EN scripts are included.
The scene remains partial. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed.
The v3.22 increment adds only source positions 81–120; the 80 v3.21 entries are preserved byte-for-byte at the JSON value level.
The two multiline lines at ordinals 95–96 remain separate source positions and were not merged.
The four countdown Sticker text payloads at ordinals 103–104 and 110–111 are translated; all surrounding Sticker control commands remain outside the translation JSON.
The 40 selected CN/EN text positions align by physical source line, type, and speaker slot. Non-text command lines in the selected range have no differences.
Mantra is a named Rhodes Island Elite Operator who previously joined Babel; the name is retained as Мантра.
